title: Drone Panorama Post-Processing: Perspective Warp, Puppet Warp, and Sky Beam Emphasis

date.basis: Embedded creation time in metadata; folder path indicates 2024 context; transcript references a multi-night pano workflow but does not provide an exact shooting date.

summary: This video presents a step-by-step drone panorama post-processing workflow focused on correcting DJI-stitch artifacts, preserving symmetric geometry, and emphasizing dramatic beams and sunset color. The speaker discusses isolating beam regions, applying perspective warp and trapezoid corrections to widen edges, and then refining with puppet warp to shape individual elements while keeping straight lines intact. The tutorial moves from stitching and cropping a high-resolution pano (~120 MP) to targeted local adjustments (white balance, color grading, and detail recovery) and exploring HDR as a selective fill. It also covers depth-building techniques like simulated lighting, dodging/burning, sky cloning, and careful horizon alignment, finishing with final crop decisions and file-management notes. The content blends technical instruction with aesthetic emphasis on foreground framing, beam drama, and color harmony in a sunset panorama.

sections.title: Peripheral distortion management and initial warp
sections.description: Open discussion on how peripheral distortion lines can warp scenes; emphasis on applying warp symmetrically and preparing subject regions for a photo merge.

sections.title: Perspective warp and trapezoid correction for beams
sections.description: Isolate beams and terrain (mountain and beam regions) and apply perspective warp; describe how DJI stitching stretches sides to create a wide-angle effect and how trapezoid rules are used to correct it.

sections.title: Puppet warp and local warping to preserve lines
sections.description: Introduce puppet warp to refine warped regions while avoiding distortion of straight lines; construct boundaries (walls) to maintain symmetry around the beam structures.

sections.title: Global light adjustments and local color management
sections.description: Demonstrates targeting the sunlit area with whites adjustments and targeted color tweaks; uses brush application to recover detail without color bleed; discusses HDR as a selective fill for enhancing beam definition.

sections.title: Simulated light and depth enhancement
sections.description: Deals with creating depth by simulating a light source, using dodge/burn and glow strategies to emphasize layers and foreground interest, while balancing color and sky.

sections.title: Final touches: sky, horizon, and workflow notes
sections.description: Covers finishing steps like cloning sky to smooth transitions, aligning horizons, cropping warped edges, refining foreground light, and noting non-savings and multiple card/workflow considerations for pano projects.

featured_techniques.technique: White balance and local color adjustments (Whites, color temp, tint)
Horizon alignment and warp-crop of edges
